timeline.body:
Close https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102953

- Update the (minor) ANTLR version, so that we use the newest ANTLR4.
- Regenerate all ANTLR-based parsers and lexers in Elasticsearch (EQL, SQL, ESQL, Painless).
- Do not commit the generated `*.interp` files as we do not use them (except for ESQL).

timeline.message:
Regenerate lexers and parsers

Applies to EQL, SQL, ESQL and Painless.
timeline.author: Alexander Spies

timeline.message: Remove .interp files for languages other than ESQL

timeline.body: I *thought* we ran something that formatted these. I think we excuse these from the tests, but I thought we still had something to blow these open.

reply.body:
Hmm, our `CONTRIBUTING.md` indeed says
> Wildcard imports (import foo.bar.baz.*) are forbidden and will cause the build to fail.

Spotless and checkstyle don't seem to care, though, and leave these alone.

I couldn't find a note on automatically expanding these during a cursory search, but if someone has pointers where to look I'll happily do so!

The `regen` command in the painless should do it.

We used to run these through checkstyle and I turned that off years ago because we had to manually mess with the generated files just to add `{}` and stuff.
But there's still some stuff in there. I think.
As the imports are not related to this issue, please raise a separate PR and let's get this in.

timeline.body: Thanks for your reviews and remarks, @mark-vieira , @costin and @nik9000 !
